name: Bryan Silva

usa: DOJ release Nov 5, 2026: Homeland Security Task Force Investigation Leads to Mexican Federal Judge’s Arrest on U.S. Charges
text: DOJ Nov 5, 2026, as posted: A Mexican judge has been arrested on a nine-count federal indictment charging him with accepting a $2 million bribe in exchange for granting bond to and ordering the release of a Canadian drug trafficker. Luis Benítez Alcántara, 49, of Mexico City, was arrested on Sunday in Colombia. He is charged in a second superseding indictment with nine counts of being an accessory after the fact. The United States will request Benítez’s extradition from Colombia. Benítez Alcántara was a district judge in Mexico City who allegedly accepted $2 million in exchange for granting bond to and ordering the release of Wedding’s second in command.
